scope: Independent tiny Coax producer and unchanged Bun observer versus immutable Coax capture observers. CPU-only Wasm execution and raw artifact/product-metadata parity; no renderer, realm, shader emission or GPU gate was repeated.

compiler.scope: Explicit older exploratory compiler image; does not match current repository compiler sources. The same four fixture Wasms were reused throughout both observer epochs.

review_fixes_exercised: Initializer runs before heap/memory observations and scalar getters; getter order is vertex_floats, max_vertices, uniform_floats, state_size.
Initializer memory.grow(1) is included in actual memory/arena metadata, not a stale initial size.
Facts inbox admission is whole before chunked writes; a 200004-byte effective facts message exceeds the former single-upload limit without truncation.
Absent or empty --dump skips final draw-pointer reads and capture JSON while preserving ordinary frame/store observations.
The first missing required export stops later SDK calls; missing key response remains defined:false,value:null.
Every pack payload is validated before catalog/facts messages; malformed table preflight may refuse earlier with exit 2.
Canonicalize the fresh owned temporary path before comparing exact HTTP upload ACK filenames (/var versus /private/var).

observer_epochs.name: reviewed
observer_epochs.snapshot_join: Root verified the whole copied repository-source closure against the actual case-0 capture.json source_inputs before the canonical-temp-only edit; actual-case0-source-readback.log is retained.
observer_epochs.terminal: Stopped at case 12: old observer passed and new observer failed on the temporary-path alias. This epoch has no passing whole-run receipt. Its successful per-case capture/parity receipts and all refusal/failure streams are retained.
observer_epochs.diagnostic: Same frozen c1 image and existing fixture under TMPDIR=/private/tmp passed case 12 with stdout exactly equal to its unchanged old baseline. This diagnosed the alias; it is not relabelled as final fix proof.

observer_epochs.name: canonical-temp
observer_epochs.reuse: Started at case 12 with the first epoch's four Wasms, packs, facts and override files. No fixture or product re-emission; no earlier passing case repeated.

cases.purpose: Versioned stores, zero update, shrink, unchanged-version skip, signed-i64 version string and particle retained bytes
Pack, facts, appended fact, extras, hash, key down/up, fractional pointer, golden, and all overrides
Pack-only first empty mesh/index entries win over later nonempty duplicates
First empty catalog wins over duplicate catalog
200004-byte effective facts inbox; exact sum and post-init getter order
Bad final draw pointer without dump is not observed
Missing key function when a key event is requested
Missing key function without a key event
Absent optional counters, stores, particle resources and hash export
Fact flag without a facts file is ignored

facts_utf8_normalization.semantics: Existing Bun Buffer UTF-8 decoding followed by UTF-8 encoding: preserve valid scalar bytes including BOM/NUL; replace each maximal malformed subpart with EF BF BD. No valid-UTF8-only input narrowing.
facts_utf8_normalization.api: pft_measure(source) counts normalized bytes; pft_write(source,out) returns the count or -1 without changing output if short. Caller retains its bounded input admission.
facts_utf8_normalization.independent_oracle: Existing Bun readFileSync(path,'utf8') and Buffer.from(text), invoked directly by the Coax-owned driver; no shared decoder implementation.
facts_utf8_normalization.development: Initial mutation exposed five surviving boundary mutations. Added explicit C0 continuation/F5 cases and made lead categories exclusive; final mutation has zero survivors. The final corpus was rerun only after that source change.

limits: These fixture epochs predate integration of the separate UTF-8 facts policy and leading-zero-i64 clock compatibility fix. They are not claims that the later capture-driver closure was executed here.
No numerical GPU agreement or realm rendering claim follows from CPU-only capture parity.
The first epoch stopped on its real failure; only its completed individual cases are admitted.
The unchanged Bun observer is retained inside source-current/aethyr/tests/capture-render-frame.ts even after live caller retirement.

retention.readback: System tar extraction followed by complete payload/readback directory diff: exit 0, no differences, including empty stdout/stderr files.
